senses.gloss: (cmp. סְפֵי) to cut, chip, slice; to take a chip, a slice.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 14:2">Tosef. Sabb. XIV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 15:2">XV</cite>), 2 <he>לא יִסְפּוֹת הימנה וכ׳</he> one must not take a chip of it (the broken cask) as a support to &c.; <cite ref="Shabbat 124b:22">Sabb. 124ᵇ</cite> <he>ולא יספות ממנה שבר וכ׳</he> he must not trim a fragment of it (break off its projecting points, Rashi) to cover with it &c.

Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. I, 12 ס׳ הימנו if he cut a piece off it. Ab. Zar. 80ᵇ ס׳ לה צואה if he offered to it (the idol) excrements (in the place of cakes, flesh &c.); a. e.—Esp. (with or without במלח) to cut slices (of melons) and salt them; to make an incision in olives and salt them.
<cite ref="Shabbat 145a:3">Sabb. 145ᵃ</cite> <he>המפצע … לסוֹפְתָן במלח</he> (Ar. <he>לסופגן</he>) if one bursts olives open … with the intention of salting them.
<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 2:6">Maasr. II, 6</cite> <he>סוֹפֵת ואוכל</he> (Var. <he>כופף</he>) he slices (and salts) and eats.

<cite ref="Tosefta Ma'asrot 2:14">Tosef. ib. II, 14</cite> <he>לא יספות במלח וכ׳</he> the laborer must not cut and salt (the fruits on which he works) and eat, unless the employer has given him permission. Y. Mass. Sh. II, 50ᵃ top <he>אבטיח שס׳ בו וכ׳</he> a melon in which he made a cut, however small &c.—[<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 4">Midr. Till. to Ps. IV</cite>, ed. Bub. <he>לספות</he>, v. <cite ref="O01348"><he>סָפָה</he></cite>.]
